## Problem description

A clear description of the problem or limitation. Example: "I'm always frustrated when ..."

Describe how you would like this to work. Be specific about the behavior you expect.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Target page

Which part of the site does this target? Mark with an x.

- [ ] Visualizer (home page or /stack-visualizer)
- [ ] Guide page (specify which one)
- [ ] Tool (/stack-frame-visualizer or /complexity-analyzer)
- [ ] Site-wide (affects many pages or the whole site)

## Additional context

Add any other context, sketches, or links about the request here.
